title: Pseudo-differential operators associated with the fractional Hankel-Bessel transform
summary: We introduce and study a new class of pseudo-differential operators associated with a fractional Hankel--Bessel transform. Motivated by the classical Hankel transform and the pseudo-differential operators associated with Bessel operators studied by Pathak and Pandey \cite{PathakPandey1995}, we define a fractional variant by inserting a fractional Fourier-type phase into the Hankel kernel.
